message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I see no new messages from Brad. This is unexpected. I booked the meeting and informed him in the last session. His final task was to send the confirmation email.

Possible scenarios:
1.  Brad is having a technical issue and couldn't send the email or update the workspace.
2.  Brad sent the email, but for some reason didn't update the workspace to let me know.
3.  Brad hasn't acted yet.

The task is only complete when the booking is created *and* the confirmation email is sent. Since I don't have confirmation that the email was sent, I cannot assume the task is complete.

I need to check in with Brad to see what the status is. A simple, polite message asking for an update is the best course of action. It will prompt him to either confirm he has sent the email or let me know if there's an issue.

My plan:
1.  Append a message to the workspace asking Brad for a status update on the confirmation email.
2.  End my session and wait for his response.

function.name: append_workspace
function.arguments: {"text":"Hi Brad, just checking in. Have you had a chance to send the confirmation email for the partner meeting on Tuesday at 9:00 AM? Let me know if there are any issues. Thanks!"}
